falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,700 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on a higher low structure; a break below this level invalidates the structural support thesis and confirms this is not a comparable bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 suggests elevated but contained stress; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than the capitulation-then-recovery pattern seen in August 2024, breaking the similarity

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further by more than 15 basis points from current levels within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with a stabilizing/un-inverting curve; renewed deepening inversion signals deteriorating growth expectations that contradict the 'bottom' narrative

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
